column5: ported;note:--skip-if-missing and exit 77 give way to KeyvaultCrypto's SetUp, which calls GTEST_SKIP when fixture_state reports AllAbsent and FAILs naming the missing roles and paths on Partial (Partial and Complete rows beside AllAbsent); the bundle private.KeyvaultCrypto is a SKIP_BUNDLE, so ctest reports it Skipped without _temp/

merged:KeyvaultCrypto.main.KeyvaultDecryptMatchesReference;note:both 16384-byte checks are ASSERT_EQs in KeyvaultCrypto's SetUp, so every KeyvaultCrypto case requires them, as the old fatal check did; the 1024-byte cap on the CPU key file stays in the loader
new;note:the old binary failed a partial set only through a read error; fixture_state now classifies it and SetUp FAILs with "partial private fixture set, missing: <role> (<path>)..."
